title: Wensleydale and British Tagine
description: A rich and creamy cheese tagine made with British cheese and a touch of spice. Serve with a side of aerated bread or as a snack on its own.
instructions: Cut the Wensleydale cheese into small cubes.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the British cheese and cook until melted and creamy.
Stir in the Wensleydale cheese cubes.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 10-15 minutes.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
